what: On first open, the period of the logo in the middle of a dark curtain bounces twice (−20px .5s circ.out → 0 .2s circ.in, the second at −18px). After a .18s pause, the scattered letters gather over 1.8s power4.out, while hidden letters slide into view .25s later over 1s circ.out. Once gathered, the logo flies to the header spot over .8s power4.out and the curtain lifts up to height 0 over .9s power4.out (fx:done)

options.hop: Bounce height (px), default 20 — the second is .9x
options.to: Selector for the head slot the logo flies to (if none, the logo does not fly and only the curtain lifts)
options.[data-fx-part=gather]: Gathering letters — initial horizontal position (px) in data-x
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: Text that hides then appears — data-x default 60

use: Ma….
note: Since this makes people wait, every duration is an option. The original starts the Hero Lottie at 2.7s — the consuming side chains it with fx:done or its own timer

from.where: index.html .rx-loader — the logo’s period bounces twice, the letters gather and fly to the top, and the curtain lifts
